Videos.title: Create a video post
Videos.description: First upload the media, then submit its storage_path. The file must exist and belong to you. Creates a processing video and queues H.264/AAC compression. Optional audio_id selects a ready library sound; audio_mode is replace (default) or mix. Muting removes the original audio. Without a library selection, audible original sound becomes a reusable track following source privacy. Poll GET /videos/{video} until published, failed or source_unavailable. source_unavailable means selected audio was deleted before publication; delete the unfinished post and submit a new selection. Managed thumbnail URLs must also belong to you. Editing times are in seconds. Creation applies trim_start/trim_end, a centered portrait 9:16 crop (fill) or letterbox (fit), brightness/contrast/saturation, original muting and audio_settings (start in sound seconds, original_volume and sound_volume from 0 to 1). Library audio loops to cover the trimmed clip. Native clients that already rendered the final audio mix must set audio_settings.rendered=true; the worker preserves uploaded audio at unity gain while retaining and validating audio_id attribution. Omit trim, crop, filters and text settings for pre-rendered pixels, and keep cover_time relative to the uploaded result. cover_time is relative to the edited output. Cropping and filters are encoded by the worker; preset labels, warmth, cut_points, text_overlay and effect_settings remain metadata only. Invalid media ranges fail processing. Editing existing posts does not re-encode media. Uploads require rights_confirmed=true, current rights_version and an explicit reuse_content boolean. Original extraction requires reuse_content=true. Legacy sound fields and scheduled_at are rejected. publication_intent defaults to immediate. For drafts, use a fresh upload created with publication_intent=draft and pass that intent here too; no custom thumbnail is accepted. Encoding retains private draft state. Poll owner release detail and use its versioned publish/schedule actions after processing_state=ready.
